facility.name: Miniminds Learning Center II, LLC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2734 HEDFELT DR, EDINBURG, TX, 78539

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The transportation vehicle used to transport children in care did not have a child safety alarm. The vehicle was purchased/leased after December 31, 2013, and is designated to seat eight or more people.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: A CPR/First aid training was not available for review. Director could not find the training in the office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: A transportation vehicle used to transport children in care did not have a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood: The Infant Daily Report is missing the Infant's Mood and Summary of Activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood (26 TAC §746.2431(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: There was no Emergency Medical Information, parent's name, telephone numbers and emergency telephone  for a child being transported from school to the operation.     Correction at Inspection: The information was placed in the transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Two children were observed not securely fastened in their highchairs, as they were only restrained by a single leg.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor play area was observed with two exposed nails.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor play area was observed with overgrown weeds and an exposed nail.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Caregivers are not consistently facilitating outdoor play for the children on a daily basis.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was witnessed yelling at the children and forcibly managing their physical placement to ensure they occupied their seats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: Three caregivers did not have the following annual training topics:   	-Child maltreatment     	(1)Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma    	(2)Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS)   (3)Understanding early childhood brain development.   	  	(1)Emergency preparedness    	(2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations ;   	(3)Administering medication  	(4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction   (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety  (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not wash their hands after restroom use.  Note: The caregiver was advised to direct the child to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The fire inspection report was not available for review.    Staff training records were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: There were no Emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for two children who are transported from school.   Corrected at Inspection: The forms were placed in the transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a gap on the bottom of the wooden fence because it was missing a horizontal wooden panel. There were exposed nails on the wooden fence which pose a safety hazard for the children during outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Three infants were not strapped in their highchairs.  Corrected at Inspection: The infants were immediately strapped during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Feeding instructions for 2 infants have not been updated. Feeding instructions for 1 infant was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies: Operation did not have a plan to handle transportation emergencies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: No drinking water was available for toddler and school-age children during mealtime and during active play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: Two-month-old infant was observed swaddled in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Two classrooms did not have an activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver was observed not washing her hands after changing children's diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Children's hands were not washed after diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website: Childrens product certification was last completed on 1/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §746.4135(c))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: Classroom was observed to not have enough toys for all of the children. Children were observed fighting with each other for toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2505(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver left three children unattended  in the after school room when the caregiver stepped out of the room to take a child to the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Two school aged children in the afterschool room were observed watching photos and videos on a cell phone.  The television in the afterschool room was on playing a cartoon not related to the planned activities. The cartoon playing on the television was (Masha and the Bear).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation did not notify child care regulation after learning about a child being injured while in care and requiring medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on preponderance of evidence gathered during the investigation, two caregivers have yelled at children in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Child/Caregiver Ratio was deficient in the infant classroom by 1 child. There were 2 caregivers with 11 children ages 1 month to 20 months old. Specified Age Group was 0-11 months old.    NOTE: This was corrected by the oldest child being moved to another group. Child/Caregiver Ratio was met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: One infant was observed in the same group of children as an 11 year old child. In another classroom, a 20-month-old was observed in the same group as a 1-month-old infant. 18-month difference was exceeded.       NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection. Children were regrouped and compliance was met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 6-month-old infant had a blanket inside their crib during nap time. Infant was awake.       NOTE: The blanket was removed by caregiver upon my arrival to the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Two activity plans posted in two classrooms in use were not dated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Notarized Affidavit for two caregivers were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: A new caregiver having unsupervised access to children in care did not have First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two infants were observed in the same group of children as a four year old child. 18-month different was exceeded.      NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection. Children were regrouped and compliance was met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: First aid training for infant caregiver was not completed prior to unsupervised access to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 out of 4 child records reviewed were missing updated Immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Documentation of Pre-service training completion was not available for review for an employee counted in child/caregiver ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: An infant was observed watching a music video on a tablet.       NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. Tablet was put away by caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drill documentation for the months of June and July 2022 showed that the exit from the building was in over three minutes. Seven and six minutes respectively.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
